title: REQ · FileStore supplies frozen contribution IDs from snapshot.yaml
summary: FileStore implements ExportSource so the export works on the real GitOps layout
description: FileStore already implements ListByRound. Add FrozenIDs reading worlds/<world>/rounds/<round>/snapshot.yaml (the file round.writeSnapshot creates) and returning the contribution ids, reporting not-frozen when the file is absent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a temp root with snapshot.yaml listing ids, When FrozenIDs is called, Then those ids are returned with frozen=true
Given no snapshot.yaml, When FrozenIDs is called, Then frozen=false and no error
Given unsafe world or round ids, When FrozenIDs is called, Then an error is returned
technical_constraints: No import of internal/round; use a local minimal yaml struct
definition_of_done: FileStore satisfies ExportSource via compile-time assertion
